messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High tail latency observed for inference-redwood-us-west1 (model-serving). 95th latency spike to ~2.7s over last 3m, error rate up to 1.8% (5xx). Triggering page.
Julian: I'm paged, taking ownership. War room link: https://meet.google.com/rdw-warroom-457 — please join if you're oncall or product leads. Quick blameless recap: latency + elevated 5xx for text-gen endpoints in us-west1; other regions look fine.
Maya: joining. seeing similar in Grafana: token throughput steady but p95 CPU on gpux-3 nodes at 96%. KV cache miss spikes correlate with the latency.
Alex: joining too. Any deploys in last 30m? @deploy-bot what was deployed to us-west1 recently?
deploy-bot: deploy: model-serving-v3.4.2 rolled to us-west1 at 2864209300 by CI. No schema or config changes flagged.
Samira: I'm looking at routing/traffic shifts — autoscaler popped new pods but they didn't stabilize: readiness probe failing on a subset, kube events show OOMKilled on 3 pods.
Julian: hypothesis: new runtime kernel + memory pressure on gpux-3 causing OOM, leading to reduced capacity and higher latency on remaining replicas. Plan: (1) scale down rollout (pause) (2) revert v3.4.2 in us-west1 to v3.4.1 canary (3) spin up warm nodes from reserved pool if needed.
Maya: I can trigger scaling and patch the HPA to lower max burst. Doing canary rollback now: `kubectl set image deploy/model-serving model-serving=image:v3.4.1 -n inference-us-west1` — holding for 2 min to observe.
Alex: I'll open a status draft for status.redwood.com. Proposed public status (short): "We are investigating elevated latency and errors for the inference API in US-West. Some requests may experience higher-than-normal latency or intermittent failures. We're actively working on mitigation and will provide updates." Any objections?
Samira: fine. Add affected scope: "hosted inference (text generation endpoints) for customers routed to us-west1; embeddings currently unaffected." Also include a customer-facing ETA line: "Next update within 30 minutes."
Julian: good. Customer notification template for account teams: "We're investigating an infrastructure issue affecting inference latency and intermittent errors for US-West. Our engineering team has paused the recent rollout and is reverting to the previous version while we restore capacity. We'll provide updates within 30 minutes. If you need immediate assistance, reply here or open a priority ticket. — Redwood SRE"
Maya: rollback shows readiness improving on 2 pods. CPU p95 trending down. Error rate dropping to 0.6%.
DevOps Rotation: Confirming warm node pool being brought online: `aws ec2 start-instances --instance-ids i-0abcde --region us-west-2` — estimated ready in ~4m.
Julian: @Samira can you coordinate with platform to mark the problematic nodes for further postmortem (kernel profiling + oom dump)? we want core dumps and runtime logs preserved.
Samira: will do, collecting dmesg + /var/log/syslog from affected nodes and saving under s3://redwood-incident-logs/2864209876/ — noting containerOOM sequence.
Alex: Posting interim status update now and pinging account channels for top 10 customers in us-west. Draft posted to #customer-comm-ops: "Interim: We have paused the recent rollout and are reverting to the prior version. Latency and errors are improving; mitigation in progress. Next update in 20 minutes." :white_check_mark:
Julian: paging confirmations: @Maya, @Alex, @Samira — confirm you received pager and are operational.
Maya: confirm, active in war room.
Alex: confirm.
Samira: confirm.
Julian: handing off monitoring to Maya for the next 30m once we see stable metrics. I'll stay watch for post-rollback regressions. If error rate stays <0.5% and p95 <1.2s for 10m, we'll declare mitigation and begin customer communication to clear.
Maya: agreed. I'll escalate to SRE Rotation if we see any re-spike. Adding runbook checkpoint: `runbooks/rollback-and-warm-pool.md` step 4 — preserve logs, tag incident id 2864209876.
DevOps Rotation: warm nodes reporting healthy. capacity back to 95%.
Julian: marking current status: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING (rollback in progress, capacity restored). Last update 2864210450. Next update 20m or earlier if change.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Incident 2864209876 updated: state=MITIGATING, owner=Julian, severity=SEV2, impact="hosted inference (us-west1) - elevated latency/5xx for text-gen endpoints".
